question: Can the Commission specify in detail the costs that the Commission has incurred for beauty treatments, hairstyling, massage or physical personal training services for Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and other members of the College of Commissioners?
Is there a beautician, hairstylist, masseuse or personal trainer employed or under contract for services to the Commission?
Are European Commissioners refunded by the Commission for expenses incurred for beauty treatments, hairstyling, massage or physical training expenses?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (27.11.2025) 1. The Commission does not cover costs for beauty treatments, hairstyling, massage or physical personal training. 2. The answer to the question of the Honourable Member is No. 3. The answer to the question of the Honourable Member is No.
